title: A finite product of flat modules is flat
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n\ge0$ an integer and $M_1,\dots,M_n$ flat $R$-modules [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Then the product $M_1\times\cdots\times M_n$, an $R$-module with the componentwise operations, is a flat $R$-module.
